locator: Basutoland, p. 302, Table 1. 1891, 1904, 1911 census columns. Row 1891, Basutoland. / Basutoland, p. 302, Table 1. 1891, 1904, 1911 census columns. Row 1904-04-18, Basutoland.
scope: Basutoland excluding Cape, Natal and Orange Free State.
method: Linear interpolation over 1553/2337. July 1 is a computational midpoint for year-only returns. 1904 Basutoland day follows the imperial census report p. 71.
uncertainty_kind: No statistical interval. War interrupted the 1901 census in southern Africa; enumeration error and changes within the intercensal period are unquantified.
